faq.q: What is the origin of Yusup?
faq.a: Yusup is associated with Arabic. Yusup is the Caucasian form of Arabic يُوسُف (Yūsuf), the Quranic form of the prophet Joseph.
Yes — the underlying form يُوسُف is Arabic.
Yusup can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Yusup should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Yūsuf is the Quranic Arabic form of the prophet Joseph and occurs in the Quran.

faq.a: In Persian, Yusup is rendered یوسف and carries the sense یوسف، نام پیامبر.
A romanized syllable approximation is yu-sup. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Yusup?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Yusup, yusup. Script forms are يُوسُف, یوسف, युसुप.

faq.q: Is Yusup a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
